stem: Karan compares the two-term ratios $2:3$ and $8:12$.

parts.text: Which claim correctly decides whether the ratios are proportional?

options.text: Yes: $2\times 12=3\times 8$, so the ratios are proportional.
No: $8$ is larger than $2$, so the ratios cannot be proportional.
Yes: both ratios use only even numbers.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Two ratios a:b and c:d are proportional when a·d=b·c. Here 2·12=24 and 3·8=24, so 2:3 and 8:12 are proportional.

teacher.key_rationale: Cross-products match (24=24), so the ratios are proportional. Comparing term size alone or parity of the entries is not the proportionality test.
